info.name: IPPIS MDA scope, transfers and overview
info.description:
Tests for MDA isolation, transfers, the per-MDA overview and the protected public registration flow.

BEFORE YOU START
1. Run database/transfer-migration.sql on the database the server uses (the other two migrations are already on Neon).
2. Start the backend with `pnpm dev` (baseUrl defaults to http://localhost:8000).
3. Set the collection variables adminUsername and adminPassword (your super admin).

RUNNING
Run the folders in order. Two requests need a sign-in code:
- 02 needs `otp` (super admin), 10 needs `hrOtp` (the test HR officer). With `pnpm dev` each code is printed in the backend terminal ("[OTP Email] DEV MODE - OTP for ...").
Everything else fills its own variables. Requests 03-05 pick the first two active MDAs and a department in each; set mdaA / mdaB yourself to test with particular MDAs.

WHAT IT WRITES
This creates real records on the database behind the server:
- two test admin accounts (deleted again in folder 7),
- two test employees, "Postman MdaA" and "Postman MdaB" (emails postman.mda.a/b.<time>@example.com), one attendance record and two transfer records. These stay; there is no delete endpoint for employees.
A run is repeatable: each run uses new usernames and emails.

item.name: 0. Setup: sign in and create the test users
01 Super Administrator login (sends OTP)

request.description: Password step of sign-in for your super admin account.

item.name: 02 Super Administrator verify OTP

request.description: Set the collection variable `otp` first. With `pnpm dev` the code is printed in the backend terminal.

item.name: 03 Active MDAs

request.description: Lists the active MDAs; the next two requests choose MDA A and MDA B among them.

exec: pm.collectionVariables.set("activeMdas", JSON.stringify(list.map(m => ({ id: String(m.id), name: m.name }))));

item.name: 04 Choose MDA A and one of its departments

request.description: Uses mdaA if you set it, otherwise the first active MDA that has a department.

exec: const mda = wanted ? mdas.find(m => m.id === String(wanted)) : mdas.find(m => depts.some(d => String(d.company_id) === m.id));
const dept = mda && depts.find(d => String(d.company_id) === mda.id);
pm.test("MDA A has a department", () => pm.expect(dept).to.be.an("object"));
pm.collectionVariables.set("mdaA", mda.id); pm.collectionVariables.set("mdaAName", mda.name); pm.collectionVariables.set("deptA", dept.id);

item.name: 05 Choose MDA B and one of its departments

request.description: Uses mdaB if you set it, otherwise the next active MDA that has a department.

exec: const mda = wanted ? mdas.find(m => m.id === String(wanted)) : mdas.find(m => m.id !== a && depts.some(d => String(d.company_id) === m.id));
const dept = mda && depts.find(d => String(d.company_id) === mda.id);
pm.test("MDA B has a department", () => pm.expect(dept).to.be.an("object"));
pm.collectionVariables.set("mdaB", mda.id); pm.collectionVariables.set("mdaBName", mda.name); pm.collectionVariables.set("deptB", dept.id);

item.name: 06 Role ids

request.description: Finds the HR Officer role.

item.name: 07 Create the MDA A HR officer account

request.description: A test account that will hold HR Officer for MDA A only.

body.raw:
{
  "username": "{{hrUsername}}",
  "email": "{{hrUsername}}@example.com",
  "password": "{{testPassword}}",
  "full_name": "Postman MDA A HR Officer",
  "role": "admin",
  "scope_level": "mda",
  "mda_id": {{mdaA}},
  "reason": "Postman MDA test"
}

item.name: 08 Give that account HR Officer for MDA A

request.description: Role assignment scoped to one MDA (ORG-01).

item.name: 09 HR officer login (sends OTP)
10 HR officer verify OTP

request.description: Set the collection variable `hrOtp` from the backend terminal first.

item.name: 1. Each MDA sees only its own registrations and employees (ORG-02, ORG-07)
11 HR officer adds an employee to MDA A

request.description: The registration is recorded under MDA A and its department.

item.name: 12 HR officer must choose an MDA

request.description: An MDA-level user cannot add an employee without an MDA.

item.name: 13 HR officer cannot add to MDA B

request.description: Adding to an MDA outside the user's scope is refused.

item.name: 14 Super Administrator adds an employee to MDA B
15 HR officer's pending list shows MDA A's registration, not MDA B's

request.description: Registrations are filtered to the user's MDA.

item.name: 16 HR officer cannot open MDA B's onboarding documents

request.description: A record outside the user's scope is answered as not found.

item.name: 17 Super Administrator approves MDA A's registration

request.description: Approval creates the employee and links them to MDA A.

item.name: 18 Super Administrator approves MDA B's registration
19 HR officer's employee list shows MDA A only

request.description: MDA B's employee is not visible to MDA A's HR officer.

exec: pm.test("every row is MDA A", () => list.forEach(e => pm.expect(String(e.company_id)).to.eql(String(pm.collectionVariables.get("mdaA")))));

item.name: 20 Super Administrator filters employees by MDA

request.description: Users with rights across all MDAs see every MDA and can filter by one.

item.name: 2. MDA isolation in attendance, leave and HR records
21 HR officer marks attendance for an MDA A employee
22 HR officer cannot mark attendance for an MDA B employee

request.description: Writing to another MDA's records is refused.

item.name: 23 HR officer cannot create leave for an MDA B employee
24 HR officer cannot read an MDA B employee's leave balances
25 HR officer cannot read an MDA B employee's emergency contacts
26 HR officer can read an MDA A employee's emergency contacts
3. Per-MDA overview (DSH-01, DSH-02)
27 HR officer's MDA list shows MDA A only

exec: pm.test("unlinked count hidden from an MDA-level user", () => pm.expect(d.unlinked_employees).to.eql(null));

item.name: 28 HR officer's overview of MDA A

request.description: Sections follow the role: HR sections, no payroll or access.

exec: pm.test("no payroll or access for an HR officer", () => { pm.expect(d).to.not.have.property("payroll"); pm.expect(d).to.not.have.property("access"); });

item.name: 29 HR officer cannot open MDA B's overview
30 Super Administrator sees every MDA
4. Transfers move people and remove old access (ORG-05)
31 Create an admin account for the MDA A employee

request.description: Linked to the employee by staff ID, as staff who also use the admin side are.

item.name: 32 Give it HR Officer for MDA A
33 HR officer requests a transfer to MDA B

request.description: Destination by id; requests always start as pending.

item.name: 34 A second open transfer for the same employee is refused
35 HR officer cannot approve

request.description: Approving needs the core HR approve permission.

item.name: 36 Super Administrator approves: the transfer completes

request.description: Effective today, so approval moves the employee and removes the access tied to MDA A.

exec: pm.test("MDA A access removed from the linked account", () => pm.expect(d.access.removed.some(g => g.account === pm.collectionVariables.get("staffUsername") && g.grant === "hr_officer")).to.be.true);

item.name: 37 The linked account no longer holds MDA A access

exec: pm.test("no MDA A role left", () => pm.expect(rows.filter(r => String(r.company_id) === String(pm.collectionVariables.get("mdaA")))).to.have.length(0));

item.name: 38 The employee has left MDA A's list

exec: pm.test("moved employee no longer in MDA A", () => pm.expect(ids).to.not.include(pm.collectionVariables.get("empA")));

item.name: 39 The completed transfer is on record
40 Super Administrator requests a future transfer
41 The requester cannot approve their own request

request.description: Separation of duties.

item.name: 42 Rejecting needs a reason
43 Reject with a reason
5. Public tracking and registration are protected
44 Tracking by IPPIS number gives the status only

request.description: No sign-in. No NIN, contact, personal or document data in the answer.

exec: pm.test("no email or NIN returned", () => { pm.expect(text).to.not.include(pm.collectionVariables.get("emailA")); pm.expect(text).to.not.include('"nin"'); });

item.name: 45 The number with someone else's email is not found
46 The number with the right email adds the first name
47 Document status no longer gives file locations
48 An approved application cannot be changed

request.description: Only the IPPIS number is needed for this public step, so approved applications are locked.

item.name: 49 An approved application cannot be resubmitted
6. Organisation structure and MDA links
50 A department must belong to an MDA

request.description: Nothing is created: the MDA is missing.

item.name: 51 Employee-to-MDA link report

request.description: How employees' registration text matches the official MDA list (read-only).

item.name: 52 Automatic linking, dry run

request.description: Shows how many employees would be linked, without changing anything.

item.name: 53 An MDA-level user cannot use the cross-MDA link report

request.description: Unlinked employees belong to no MDA, so only users with rights across all MDAs see them (ORG-08).

item.name: 7. Cleanup
54 Delete the linked staff account
55 Delete the HR officer account
